text:
Maria: Hey infra team — kicking off account/project + VPC scaffold for a new GPU inference cluster in eu-north-1. Goal: Dedicated pool for low-latency serving (NVIDIA A100 equivalent). Can we run through a short, validated onboarding checklist?

Sam: +1. Minimal checklist off top of head: link billing account, create project, enable APIs, SAs, IAM roles, request GPU quota, set up VPC CIDR plan, subnets for k8s nodes/control plane, NAT/bastion, private DNS + peering to shared services, flow logs, service perimeter if needed.

AJ: I can drop a quick terraform pattern for the VPC + subnet layout we like. Example (keep names/tags consistent with org modules):
```
module "vpc_eunorth" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood-terraform-modules//vpc"
  name   = "rwd-eu-north-1-vpc"
  cidr   = "10.40.0.0/16"
  subnets = {
    control = "10.40.0.0/24"
    nodes   = "10.40.1.0/22"
    services = "10.40.8.0/24"
  }
  tags = { env = "prod" team = "inference" }
}
```
Note: choose /22 for nodes to leave room for pod-ip allocation.

Leo: GPU quota request is slow in this provider — start that today. Steps: open quota ticket via console, attach expected sustained vCPU/GPU and target date, cc support + account manager. For A100s say: 8 GPUs initially, request uplift to 32 within 8 weeks. Also include network egress estimate for cost forecasting.

infra-bot: Ticket created: Q-54321 (provider quota request). ETA: 3-7 business days. Link: https://provider.example/ticket/Q-54321

Ops: A few security/ops callouts:
- Create dedicated service account for node bootstrap with least privilege.
- KMS keys: create per-environment customer-managed key and grant encrypt/decrypt to infra SA.
- VPC flow logs to central logging project, retention 30d default.
- Private endpoint for registry + model storage.
- Route tables: explicit routes for peered shared-services VPC, deny 0.0.0.0/0 on node subnets except via NAT.

Maria: For DNS and peering: we need split-horizon private DNS so cluster can resolve redis/metrics in shared-services. Are there previous peering templates we should reuse? Also can someone confirm IP overlap check with existing regions (eu-west, eu-central) — we want no overlap.

AJ: Reuse the peering module: `module.shared_peering`. Quick ip check command I use: `python -c "import ipaddress; print(ipaddress.ip_network('10.40.0.0/16').overlaps(ipaddress.ip_network('10.41.0.0/16')) )"` — will script this in the onboarding repo.

Sam: Ownership & handoff items:
- Infra engineer assigned (Maria) — builds TF in feature branch
- Quota ticket (Leo) — monitor and confirm
- Security review (Ops) — once TF plan and SA/IAM shown
- Cost forecast (FinOps) — once egress + GPU hours estimated
- Canaries: create 1-node test cluster in the new VPC before full cluster bootstrap

Leo: Cost notes: on-demand GPUs estimate ~ $X/hr; include reserved pricing options and accelerated commit discussion with provider if usage ramps. Also add network egress alert thresholds in console.

Ops: Validation checklist to tick before handoff:
1) Billing linked & budget alert present
2) GPU quota granted and visible
3) TF plan applied in staging project, no drift
4) Security groups / NSGs locked down, only control plane ports open
5) KMS and IAM verified for node SA
6) Private DNS resolution to shared services confirmed
7) VPC flow logs flowing to logging project
8) Bastion/NAT verified and can pull images from registry
9) Smoke cluster bootstrapped and passes basic inference perf tests

Maria: Timeline proposal: start TF work today, submit GPU quota request now (Leo), smoke cluster by EOD next Wednesday, full handoff to platform on Friday next week.

Sam: I'll add this as a runbook PR to `infra/onboarding/runbooks/region-bootstrap.md` with the exact command snippets and checklist.

infra-bot: PR created: repo/infra#482 - "eu-north-1 GPU cluster onboarding runbook" by Sam

Maria: Thanks everyone — assigning followups: @Leo - quota, @AJ - TF modules + peering script, @Ops - security review. Will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

Ops: Noted. If quota comes back partial, we should plan a phased node pool (cpu-only fallback + smaller GPU nodes) so we can start validation without waiting for full count.

Maria: Good call. We'll keep a fallback plan. Will update thread with links to PRs and ticket IDs as they appear.
